flower_name: Green hydrangea, calla lily & waxflower arrangement
common_name: Hydrangea, calla lily, waxflower and scabiosa
scientific_name: Hydrangea macrophylla; Zantedeschia; Chamelaucium uncinatum; Scabiosa
notes: A compact, textural arrangement centered on chartreuse green hydrangea, with white and deep plum calla lilies, magenta waxflower sprays, and a dark pincushion-like scabiosa bloom. The lime, cream, magenta, and near-black palette creates a vivid contrast between fresh green massing and sculptural accents.
